about: Stages and timing for the revenue-drop playbook. scripts/handoff.py reads this file: the stages it tracks, the outcomes each stage can record, and how long to wait between stages. Each key is explained under notes.

stages.name: explain
stages.do: Break the drop down and rank its causes; add each candidate cause as a finding, and note which suspects it already ruled out.

stages.name: feeds
stages.do: Check the pixel, the catalog feeds and the index jobs. Record ruled_out without running it when the explainer's pixel and catalog checks were clean.

skip_when.reason: the change is within normal variation: there is no incident to chase.

stages.name: api
stages.do: Check whether search itself broke: request volumes and errors by type and day. Record ruled_out when the explainer's daily shape shows no outage.

skip_when.reason: the change is within normal variation: there is no incident to chase.

stages.name: journeys
stages.do: Check whether a live Engagement flow stopped sending or broke. Record ruled_out when the drop is all in search or category browsing with no fall in returning traffic.

skip_when.reason: the change is within normal variation: there is no incident to chase.

stages.name: change
stages.do: Measure the recent merchandising change the explainer suspects: did it cause the drop?

skip_when.reason: the change is within normal variation: there is no incident to chase.

stages.name: rollback
stages.do: Switch off (or end) the rule that made it worse, from a fresh read and its own plan, staging first, each batch after its own yes.

skip_when.reason: the change is within normal variation: there is no incident to chase.

stages.name: recovery
stages.do: After the fix has had time, compare the days since the fix with the days of the drop: did revenue recover?

skip_when.reason: the change is within normal variation: there is no incident to chase.

notes.recovery_check_days: Days after the rollback stage finishes before the recovery stage is due. A week gives a whole weekday cycle after the fix, and Discovery reporting runs about 2 days behind. When the fix was a feed or flow repair outside this run, or the rollback was skipped, record the fix date plus this on the recovery stage with stage --not-before.
notes.wait_outcomes: Outcomes that mean a stage isn't finished yet: the recovery stage found too few days since the fix in the reports. The script records them only with status in_progress and a --not-before date to come back on. The change stage's too_early_to_tell is a final outcome here, not a wait: in an incident the rollback decision can't wait for two weeks of data, so it rests on discovery-rule-cleanup's own impact check.
notes.playbooks: Each playbook's title, product and stages in order. A stage names the skill that does it, whether that skill writes, which product it needs in a run on both (product), what to do, the outcomes it can record, not_before (wait this rules key's number of days after another stage is done) and skip_when (suggest skipping when another stage had one of these outcomes, or was skipped). Checks the explainer already ruled out record ruled_out, which says why they weren't run; only a drop within normal variation skips the rest of the run.
